title: 외국법자문사법 시행규칙 / queue:ARTICLE:3:2:00004:part:1/1
full_text:
Article 3(2) (Preparation of Pre-Assessment of Professional Ethics, etc.)
(1) Candidates for members of the Ministry of Justice Disciplinary Committee, as defined in Article 40(2)(1) and (3) to (5) of the Act, must prepare a pre-assessment of professional ethics in accordance with Form 1, and the Minister of Justice must verify the suitability of each candidate as a member based on the results of the pre-assessment before appointing them.
(2) If a candidate for a member of the Ministry of Justice Disciplinary Committee is appointed as described in (1), the appointed member (hereinafter referred to as "External Member of the Ministry of Justice Disciplinary Committee") must prepare a professional ethics verification form in accordance with Form 2.
